entities.name: Sharp-Ear
entities.description: A kitsune ranger and yabusame archer from Sugi Hayashi, brother of Pearl-Ear, who mentored Michiko Konda.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: A student taught yabusame by Sharp-Ear.

entities.name: Eiganjo Castle
entities.description: Castle where Sharp-Ear was placed as Michiko's mentor.

entities.name: Riko
entities.description: Companion who left Eiganjo with Michiko and Choryu.

entities.name: Captain Nagao
entities.description: Leader of a failed assault on the akki army.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: A massing army assaulted by Captain Nagao.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Enemies in whose territory Sharp-Ear's company was captured.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Owner of the cave to which the company traveled.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which these events occurred.

events.summary: Sharp-Ear comes to Eiganjo Castle and is placed as mentor to Michiko Konda, teaching her yabusame.
events.quote: Sharp-Ear came to Eiganjo Castle during the Kami War and was placed as a mentor for Michiko Konda

events.summary: When Michiko leaves with Riko and Choryu, Sharp-Ear uses kitsune magic to separate them and lure them to Sugi Hayashi.
events.quote: Sharp-Ear used his kitsune magic to separate them and lure them to Sugi Hayashi

events.summary: Sharp-Ear joins Captain Nagao's failed assault on the akki army and breaks his arm dragging the captain to safety.
events.quote: he broke his arm dragging the captain to safety

events.summary: Sharp-Ear and the others go into orochi territory, are captured and imprisoned, then free themselves.
events.quote: he and the others were captured and imprisoned

events.summary: Sharp-Ear travels with the company to Toshiro Umezawa's cave, where they fight the orochi again.
events.quote: traveled with the company to Toshiro Umezawa 's cave, where they once more fought the orochi

relations.quote: teaching her the ways of the yabusame - mounted archery

relations.note: Joined his assault and rescued him
relations.quote: Sharp-Ear then joined Captain Nagao 's failed assault
